# Balloon Pop

> A browser game for kids: balloons float up the screen and you pop them. There is a classic score
> mode plus learning modes for colors, shapes, numbers and letters in 11 languages. Agents can play by
> clicking balloons like a human, through WebMCP tools, or through the JavaScript API on `window.BalloonPop`.

## Start here: agent mode (turn-based)
Open https://codejq.github.io/BalloonPop/?agent=1 (or call `BalloonPop.start({mode, agent: true})`).
In agent mode the game is FROZEN while you think. After each action (a click/tap, or an API pop) it runs
for about 1.5 s, then freezes again, so balloons do not escape while you decide. A badge at the bottom
says "paused, waiting for your move" or "running". Hovering never pops balloons in agent mode.
Change the run time with `?step=2500` or `BalloonPop.setAgentMode(true, 2500)`.
Deep links work too: `?agent=1&mode=colors&level=1`, `?agent=1&mode=numbers&learn=1`.

To play by clicking (computer use): read the prompt at the top ("Find: red"), click the matching balloon's
centre, take a new screenshot. Clicking empty sky just lets the game run a little.

## WebMCP tools
If your browser exposes `navigator.modelContext` (WebMCP), the page registers these tools:
`balloonpop_start {mode, level?, learn?, explore?}`, `balloonpop_look`, `balloonpop_pop {id}`,
`balloonpop_pop_all_safe`, `balloonpop_wait {ms?}`. Each returns a plain-text description of the screen,
and they always use agent mode.

## Modes
- `freeplay`: 3 minutes to reach 150 points. Normal balloon +1, pink heart balloon +5, evil balloon
  (red, spiky, angry face) -10. Dropping below -100 loses. In this mode hovering the mouse over a balloon pops it.
- `colors`, `shapes`, `numbers`, `letters`: a prompt at the top says what to find ("Find: red") and a
  voice says it. Pop balloons that match. Wrong pops count as misses. Clear the level's goal (7-12 correct
  pops) to finish; fewer misses earn more stars (0-1 misses = 3 stars). Level N+1 unlocks after level N.
- Explore (`explore: true` in any learning mode): no goal, every pop says the balloon's name.
- Learn (`learn: true`, numbers and letters only): pop the items in order (1 → 20, or the whole alphabet).
  The prompt shows the sequence with the next item highlighted; each pop says the item aloud. Wrong
  balloons wobble instead of popping and count as misses.

## JavaScript API (run in the page, e.g. with a browser tool's "evaluate JS")
- `BalloonPop.help()`: prints this API summary.
- `BalloonPop.describe()`: plain-text summary of the screen: target, progress, and every visible balloon with
  its id, position and "<- POP" / "<- AVOID". Easiest way to decide the next move.
- `await BalloonPop.step(ms)`: let the game run for `ms` (agent mode) and get the new state.
- `BalloonPop.setAgentMode(on, stepMs)`: turn agent mode on or off.
- `BalloonPop.modes()`: `[{mode, levels, explore}]`.
- `BalloonPop.start({mode: 'colors', level: 1, agent: true})`: starts a game. `agent: true` = turn-based.
  `speed` < 1 slows balloons. `explore: true` starts explore mode, `learn: true` learn-in-order mode.
- `BalloonPop.getState()`: returns
  `{status, mode, level, target: {key, word}, score, goal, correct, mistakes, timeLeft, balloons: [...]}`.
  `status` is `menu`, `playing`, `paused`, `won` or `lost`.
  Each balloon: `{id, kind, color, value, key, isTarget, shouldPop, x, y, visible}`. `x`/`y` are viewport
  coordinates of the balloon centre. `shouldPop` is the right move: target balloons in learning modes,
  anything but evil balloons in freeplay.
- `BalloonPop.pop(id)`: pops one balloon and returns `{ok, correct, points, score}`.
- `BalloonPop.popAllSafe()`: pops every visible balloon with `shouldPop: true` and returns the count.
- `BalloonPop.pause()`, `resume()`, `home()`, `setSpeed(n)`, `setLanguage('fr')`, `languages()`.

A simple winning loop:
    BalloonPop.start({mode: 'shapes', level: 1, agent: true});
    while (BalloonPop.getState().status === 'playing') { BalloonPop.popAllSafe(); await BalloonPop.step(1200); }

## Playing without JavaScript (DOM / accessibility tree)
- Home screen: buttons `.mode-card[data-mode=...]`. Level screen: `#btn-explore` and `.level-btn[data-level=N]`.
- Prompt: `#prompt` (its aria-label says what to find). Stats: `#stats`. Pause: `#btn-pause`.
- Each balloon is `div.balloon[role=button]` with a unique `id` and an `aria-label` naming it, e.g.
  "red balloon", "7 balloon" or "Evil balloon - do NOT pop (-10 points)".
- URL parameters: `?mode=colors&level=2`, `?mode=letters&explore=1`, `?mode=numbers&learn=1`, `?speed=0.2`, `?lang=es`, `?agent=1`, `?step=2500`.
